title: The Grotesque Miniature and Black Humor as Survival

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: István Örkény created the Hungarian 'grotesque' through his *Egyperces novellák* (One-Minute Stories). Shaped by the war, which he lived through as a forced labourer on the Don front and as a Soviet prisoner of war (1943–46) (check), his grotesque looks at absurdity with calm, deadpan sobriety (*hűvös tárgyilagosság*).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: In the grotesque, as the text describes it, there is a clash of two irreconcilable realities collide: a matter-of-fact bureaucratic tone applied to existential horror or death.
